title: Yi Jia Liow
text:
I am a postdoctoral scholar in the Department Gastroenterology at Duke University. I received my PhD from the University of Tokyo in 2026.
My research focuses on gut sensing of dietary substrates and how that information is relayed to the brain.
Outside of research, I make ceramics.
You can reach me at yijia.liow@gmail.com.
